literal_definitions.name: KernelDecisionHistory
literal_definitions.meaning: History_t=(Fin t->I)x(Fin t->R), past actions and observations only; observation carrier unrestricted real.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: KernelDecisionSampler
literal_definitions.meaning: f_t:History_t->I->I. Output subtype gives bounds; no measurability or law correctness from type alone.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelGeneratedActions
literal_definitions.meaning: Empty vector at0; recursively restrict prefixes then append f_t(past_actions,past_observations)(u_t). Literal context, not proof evidence.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelCausalPolicy
literal_definitions.meaning: Takes full tape and t past observations, reconstructs past actions, then uses fresh tape coordinate t.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelGeneratedHistory
literal_definitions.meaning: Pair of recursively generated t actions and t observation prefix.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelGeneratedPrediction
literal_definitions.meaning: Causal policy applied to full tape and strict-past outcome prefix; returns I.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelUniformTapeLaw
literal_definitions.meaning: Infinite product of volume on I; probability and independent-coordinate properties need proof/reuse.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: kernelGameLaw
literal_definitions.meaning: Product of uniform tape law and arbitrary probability law nu on outcome streams; tape independent of entire outcome stream.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: expectedFixedMinimum
literal_definitions.meaning: sInf over constant u in[0,1] of expected cumulative squared loss; infimum outside expectation.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.

literal_definitions.name: expectedFixedRegret
literal_definitions.meaning: Expected learner cumulative loss minus expectedFixedMinimum.
literal_definitions.source_relation: Added formal model or benchmark, not a printed literal definition.
